scope: Follow-up to merged PR #6047: worker pre-submit approval and shared execute/rollback convergence predicate
behavior: Worker compares durable intent with current proposal and routing boundary, then re-reads Governance immediately before adapter.submit. Invalid/unavailable approval has zero submit, readback, convergence or compensation calls; proposal stays approved. API execute and rollback-followthrough reuse this predicate and retain 403/503 mappings. Body actor_role grants no authority.

HTTP success proves Governance read before submit and independent convergence re-read. Existing API suites retain forged-body-role and rollback rejection coverage. Temporary stores/scripted downstream are not hosted acceptance.
